title: ELVHYS 4.2 - Leakage into cold room/tank connection space considering barriers and obstacles
facility: 1 m3 transfer connection space, HSE Science & Research Centre, Buxton, UK
claim_boundary: This CC0 cryogenic consequence dataset can support a bounded leak, pressure-peaking or ignition extension, but it is not gaseous H70 station-to-vehicle filling validation. Direct transfer to the H70 model requires a declared domain-transfer protocol and a frozen subset with hashes.
next_action: If the model scope is explicitly extended to cryogenic transfer spaces, download a frozen subset, retain file hashes and preregister a no-fitting consequence-validation protocol.
